Name: (CP) Steven Universe Foods
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Here we are in the future! A future full of a bunch of delicious and nutritionally suspicious foods from Steven Universe!

This features:

- 13 Cookable items, with recipes either obtained from friendship, or the saloon.

- 1 new tree and resulting fruit that can be purchased from the Casino

- 7 drinks with unique effects that you can purchase from the Saloon or Sandy!

All items you can cook can be made with vanilla items, and they all have gift tastes for vanilla NPCs! 

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.

[/b]I figured it made a bit more sense to release a separate version instead of adding the content patcher version to the older mod page. I think it would create less confusion :)

Where to get things:

[spoiler]
The recipes for Lion Lickers, Pizza Bagels, and Waffle Sandwiches can be bought from Gus at the Saloon

Drink Up, Guacola, and Sugar Shock Shutdown can also be bought from Gus

Beast and Durian Juice can be bought from the Oasis

Canned Corn can be bought from Pierre's as well as unlocked with 9 hearts with George

Zoo Sapling requirements: Earn 100k and Mr.Qi will send you a letter in the mail that unlocks the ability to purchase the saplings from the casino

The Cheeseball Cake Recipe can be unlocked from Vincent at 6 hearts

The Cookie Cat Recipe can be unlocked from Sandy at 4 hearts

The Fire Salt Donuts Recipe can be unlocked from Shane with 5 hearts

The Mayo Sandwich Recipe can be unlocked with 4 hearts with Jodi

The Spicy Pretzel Recipe can be unlocked with 5 hearts with Lewis

The Pine Needle Tea Recipe can be unlocked with 2 hearts with Linus

The Protes Protein Bar can be unlocked with 5 hearts with Alex

The Pumpkin Bread Recipe can be unlocked with 5 hearts with Caroline

The Ube Roll Recipe can be unlocked from Evelyn at 9 hearts. [/spoiler]
